claims.head: Ottawa’s power play has a target
claims.body: Ottawa ranks 9th of 32 on the power play (7.8 expected goals per 60); Boston ranks 27th on the penalty kill.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 1 and 3 games this season

check.measure: expected goals per 60 on the power play
check.rule: held if tonight's figure is at or above the team's usual level; partly if between the league average and that level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Two of the league’s heaviest-hitting teams
claims.body: Ottawa’s hit score is 114 (3rd of 32) and Boston’s is 106 (10th). 100 is league average, after adjusting for each arena’s scorer.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 1 and 3 games this season

check.measure: hits per 60 in close games, both teams, as a score against league average (arena-adjusted)
check.rule: held if tonight's combined hit score is at or above the two teams' average; partly if above 100; otherwise didn't happen

notes.text: C. McAvoy has not played this season. M. Lohrei is in his usual spot beside J. Aspirot, up from third-pair minutes last season. That pair is getting 15:08 a game at 5-on-5, up from 12:59 with McAvoy. W. Borgen has moved into Lohrei’s old spot beside H. Lindholm.
